reviews.consumers: No new consuming entry. Proposed countably-closed-forcing/no-new-reals/CH continuation uses the existing [forcing theorem](entries/forcing-theorem/entry.html#forcing-theorem), [generic extension ZFC theorem](entries/forcing-extensions/entry.html#zfc-extension), and [regularity of omega_1](entries/cofinality/entry.html#omega-one-regular).
reviews.outcome: UNGER-03 records an invalid supremum estimate in the written proof of the true cardinal-preservation lemma; the lemma itself is not rejected. Use a ground-model union-cardinality bound instead. Countable closure must hold inside the ground model, and the descending decision sequence must be constructed there. Supply the full no-new-countable-sequences/no-new-reals proof rather than citing the exercise as a supplied proof. The CH construction preserves omega_1 and adds no reals, but can collapse larger cardinals. This is the 2013 publication; no assessment is transferred to the separately registered 2014 version.
